purpose: Predeclared before any result: 2 pilot songs (pipeline check, not in totals) and 20 evaluation songs for scoring Vibe Guitar auto charts against public, time-aligned chord annotations (Linear VGT-7). Complexity rule (from the annotation, N and X ignored): complex when >= 20 distinct labels or >= 40% of chord time is not a plain major/minor triad; simple when <= 10 labels and < 20%; otherwise moderate. Upload rule: the same studio recording on an official channel ('Topic' preferred), length within 2 s of annotationDurationSec; otherwise the song stays unscored.

isophonics-the-beatles.btcTraining: Likely.
